046        public static DerelictShipData createHull(String hullId, Random random, float sModProb) {
047                List<String> list = Global.getSettings().getHullIdToVariantListMap().get(hullId);
048                WeightedRandomPicker<String> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<String>(random);
049                picker.addAll(list);
050                String variantId = picker.pick();
051                if (variantId == null) {
052                        return null;
053                }
054                return createVariant(variantId, random, sModProb);
055        }
056        public static DerelictShipData createVariant(String variantId, Random random, float sModProb) {
057                ShipCondition condition = pickDerelictCondition(random);
058                PerShipData ship = new PerShipData(variantId, condition, sModProb);
059                return new DerelictShipData(ship, true);
060        }
061        
062        public static DerelictShipData createRandom(String factionId, DerelictType type, Random random) {
063                return createRandom(factionId, type, random, 0f);
064        }
065        public static DerelictShipData createRandom(String factionId, DerelictType type, Random random, float sModProb) {
066                if (random == null) random = new Random();
067                if (type == null) type = pickDerelictType(random);
068                String variantId = null;
069                switch (type) {
070                case CIVILIAN: variantId = pickCivilianVariantId(factionId, random); break;
071                case LARGE: variantId = pickLargeVariantId(factionId, random); break;
072                case MEDIUM: variantId = pickMediumVariantId(factionId, random); break;
073                case SMALL: variantId = pickSmallVariantId(factionId, random); break;
074                }
075                
076                if (variantId == null) return null;
077                
078                ShipCondition condition = pickDerelictCondition(random);
079                
080                PerShipData ship = new PerShipData(variantId, condition, sModProb);
081                
082                return new DerelictShipData(ship, true);
083        }
084        
085        public static DerelictType pickDerelictType(Random random) {
086                if (random == null) random = new Random();
087                WeightedRandomPicker<DerelictType> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<DerelictType>(random);
088                
089                picker.add(DerelictType.CIVILIAN, 10f);
090                picker.add(DerelictType.LARGE, 5f);
091                picker.add(DerelictType.MEDIUM, 10f);
092                picker.add(DerelictType.SMALL, 20f);
093                
094                return picker.pick();
095        }
096        public static ShipCondition pickDerelictCondition(Random random) {
097                if (random == null) random = new Random();
098                WeightedRandomPicker<ShipCondition> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<ShipCondition>(random);
099                
100                picker.add(ShipCondition.WRECKED, 10f);
101                picker.add(ShipCondition.BATTERED, 10f);
102                picker.add(ShipCondition.AVERAGE, 7f);
103                picker.add(ShipCondition.GOOD, 5f);
104                picker.add(ShipCondition.PRISTINE, 1f);
105                
106                boolean reduceQuality = Misc.isExtended() && Global.getSettings().getBoolean("ext_reduceDerelictQuality");
107                if (reduceQuality) {
108                        picker.clear();
109                        picker.add(ShipCondition.WRECKED, 50f);
110                        picker.add(ShipCondition.BATTERED, 25f);
111                        picker.add(ShipCondition.AVERAGE, 7f);
112                        picker.add(ShipCondition.GOOD, 3f);
113                        picker.add(ShipCondition.PRISTINE, 1f);
114                }
115                
116                return picker.pick();
117        }

199        public static String pickVariant(String factionId, Random random, Object ... shipRoles) {
200                if (random == null) random = new Random();
201                
202                FactionAPI faction = Global.getSector().getFaction(factionId);
203                
204                WeightedRandomPicker<String> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<String>(random);
205                for (int i = 0; i < shipRoles.length; i += 2) {
206                        String role = (String) shipRoles[i];
207                        Float weight = (Float) shipRoles[i + 1];
208                        picker.add(role, weight);
209                }
210                
211                Set<String> variantsForRole = new HashSet<String>();
212                while (variantsForRole.isEmpty() && !picker.isEmpty()) {
213                        String role = picker.pickAndRemove();
214                        if (role == null) return null;
215                        
216                        variantsForRole = faction.getVariantsForRole(role);
217                }
218                
219                picker.clear();
220                picker.addAll(variantsForRole);
221                String variantId = picker.pick();
222                
223                return variantId;
224        }

254        public void init(SectorEntityToken entity, Object params) {
255                super.init(entity, params);
256                //this.entity = (CustomCampaignEntityAPI) entity;
257                data = (DerelictShipData) params;
258                
259                angVel = 5f + (float) Math.random() * 10f;
260                angVel *= Math.signum((float) Math.random() - 0.5f);
261                
262                readResolve();
263                
264                entity.setSensorProfile(1f);
265                entity.setDiscoverable(false);
266                
267                float range = getDetectedAtRange(member.getHullSpec().getHullSize());
268                
269                // "gen" is id used when spawning salvage entity by default
270                // so this overrides that value
271                entity.getDetectedRangeMod().modifyFlat("gen", range);
272                
273                ((CustomCampaignEntityAPI)entity).setRadius(getRadius(member.getHullSpec().getHullSize()));
274                
275                // add some default salvage
276                // some uses of this will want to clear that out and add something more specific
277                DropData data = new DropData();
278                data.group = Drops.BASIC;
279                data.value = (int) getBasicDropValue(member);
280                entity.addDropValue(data);
281                
282//              data = new DropData();
283//              data.group = Drops.ANY_HULLMOD_LOW;
284//              data.chances = 1;
285//              entity.addDropRandom(data);
286
287                if (this.data.canHaveExtraCargo) {
288                        // why add this as extraSavlage instead of drops?
289                        // because needs to be based on cargo capacity not cargo value (which all drops are)
290                        long seed = Misc.getSalvageSeed(entity);
291                        Random r = Misc.getRandom(seed, 2);
292                        float extraProb = 0.5f;
293                        if (r.nextFloat() < extraProb) {
294                                if (member.getVariant().isFreighter()) {
295                                        WeightedRandomPicker<DropGroupRow> picker = DropGroupRow.getPicker(Drops.FREIGHTER_CARGO);
296                                        picker.setRandom(new Random(seed));
297                                        CargoAPI extraSalvage = Global.getFactory().createCargo(true);
298                                        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
299                                                DropGroupRow pick = picker.pick();
300                                                if (pick.isCommodity()) {
301                                                        extraSalvage.addCommodity(pick.getCommodity(), 
302                                                                                         (int)Math.ceil(member.getCargoCapacity() * (0.15f + 0.15f * r.nextFloat())));
303                                                }
304                                        }
305                                        BaseSalvageSpecial.addExtraSalvage(extraSalvage, entity.getMemoryWithoutUpdate(), -1);
306                                } else if (member.getVariant().isTanker()) {
307                                        CargoAPI extraSalvage = Global.getFactory().createCargo(true);
308                                        extraSalvage.addFuel((int)Math.ceil(member.getFuelCapacity() * (0.25f + 0.25f * r.nextFloat())));
309                                        BaseSalvageSpecial.addExtraSalvage(extraSalvage, entity.getMemoryWithoutUpdate(), -1);
310                                }
311                        }
312                }
313                
314                
315                
316                
317                // can't be "discovered" by default, but something else could setDiscoverable(true)
318                // in which case this XP value will matter
319                entity.setDiscoveryXP((float) data.value * 0.05f);
320                
321                entity.setSalvageXP((float) data.value * 0.15f);
322                
323                //this.data.durationDays = 1f;
324
325        }

328                switch (size) {
329                case CAPITAL_SHIP: return 40f;
330                case CRUISER: return 35f;
331                case DESTROYER: return 30f;
332                case FRIGATE: return 25f;
333                }
334                return 20f;

362        Object readResolve() {
363                //sprite = new GenericFieldItemSprite(entity, category, key, cellSize, size, spawnRadius);
364                if (data.ship.variantId != null) {
365                        member = Global.getFactory().createFleetMember(FleetMemberType.SHIP, data.ship.variantId);
366                } else {
367                        member = Global.getFactory().createFleetMember(FleetMemberType.SHIP, data.ship.variant);
368                }
369                
370                scale = Misc.getCampaignShipScaleMult(member.getHullSpec().getHullSize());
371                
372                //scale *= 5f;
373                
374                sprite = new GenericCampaignEntitySprite(entity, member.getHullSpec().getSpriteName(), scale);
375                
376                SpriteAPI base = Global.getSettings().getSprite(member.getHullSpec().getSpriteName());
377                SpriteAPI overlay = Global.getSettings().getSprite("misc", "campaignDerelictOverlay");
378                float w = base.getWidth();
379                float h = base.getHeight();
380                float size = Math.max(w, h) * 3f * scale;
381                overlay.setSize(size, size);
382                sprite.setOverlay(overlay);
383                
384//              SpriteAPI glow = Global.getSettings().getSprite("misc", "campaignDerelictOverlay");
385//              glow.setSize(size, size);
386//              sprite.setGlow(glow);
387                
388                return this;
389        }

391        protected float elapsed = 0f; 
392        protected Boolean expiring = null;
393        public void advance(float amount) {
394                if (entity.isInCurrentLocation()) {
395                        float turn = amount * angVel;
396                        entity.setFacing(Misc.normalizeAngle(entity.getFacing() + turn));
397                }
398                
399//              if (!entity.hasTag(Tags.NON_CLICKABLE)) {
400//                      Misc.fadeAndExpire(entity);
401//              }
402                
403                float days = Global.getSector().getClock().convertToDays(amount);
404                elapsed += days;
405                
406                if (elapsed > data.durationDays && expiring == null) {
407                        VisibilityLevel vis = entity.getVisibilityLevelToPlayerFleet();
408                        boolean playerCanSee = entity.isInCurrentLocation() && 
409                                                                        (vis == VisibilityLevel.COMPOSITION_AND_FACTION_DETAILS ||
410                                                                         vis == VisibilityLevel.COMPOSITION_DETAILS);
411                        if (!playerCanSee) {
412                                Misc.fadeAndExpire(entity, 1f);
413                                expiring = true;
414                        }
415                }
416        }

418        public float getRenderRange() {
419                return entity.getRadius() + 100f;
420        }
421
422        public void render(CampaignEngineLayers layer, ViewportAPI viewport) {
423                float alphaMult = viewport.getAlphaMult();
424                alphaMult *= entity.getSensorFaderBrightness();
425                alphaMult *= entity.getSensorContactFaderBrightness();
426                if (alphaMult <= 0) return;
427                
428                sprite.render(0, 0, entity.getFacing(), alphaMult);
429        }
